verdict.rationale: An audit trail of who changed what and when is a fair question for accounting software, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a change log or audit history in QuickBooks Online. The closest items are adjacent features: custom roles and permissions, backup and restore, and reconciliation and discrepancy reports. None of these records per-user, timestamped edits across the ledger, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
